stage: Reliable manipulation: continuous retention and controlled release

observations: Both failed towers retained the final cylinder through the high lift.
Seed 3 lost the cylinder during lowering; seed 4 lost it during horizontal transfer.
The controller then continued an empty descent and release while each cylinder rolled out of bounds at approximately 0.23 to 0.25 metres per second.
Ordinary-object size-aware grasp heights were approximately 1 to 2 millimetres above the baseline TCP heights because manifest height and observed top use different reference frames.

experiments.behavior: Check bilateral pad contact every physics step during loaded lift, transfer and lowering; abort after 12 consecutive misses and skip the remaining placement path.
experiments.decision: Not promoted: contained and recovered the seed-3 loss, but did not beat baseline and seed 4 still exceeded the settling limit.

experiments.behavior: monitored-v1 plus at-most-10-mm Cartesian lowering waypoints and a 120-step grasped hold before release.
experiments.decision: Rejected: controlled descent and dwell regressed matched tower completion.

experiments.behavior: Preserve baseline grasp and placement geometry; apply a discrete trapezoidal 0.00005-radian-per-step-squared limit to loaded joint motion with continuous contact monitoring.
experiments.decision: Rejected before the five-scene screen: seed 4 recovered, but seed 3 lost the cylinder during initial lift; the object was moving at about 0.38 m/s when monitoring aborted.

next_target: Use an end-effector-space velocity/acceleration controller or improve gripper contact mechanics; joint-target ramping alone was ineffective. Require more than 4/5 matched towers before a 20-scene validation.
